anti_overlap: fd-playwright-dom-extraction covers Playwright mechanics for DOM and style extraction
fd-component-pattern-cataloging covers visual composition and structural patterns in default state
fd-uiux-workflow-plugin covers workflow automation and plugin packaging
decision_lens: Prioritizes findings that encode decisions about user mental models: how apps handle uncertainty, failure, first-use, and edge cases.
focus: How to systematically extract and document UX flows, empty states, error handling, onboarding patterns, and micro-interactions
name: fd-ux-flow-and-state-analysis
persona: A UX researcher who specializes in flow audits and friction mapping, with experience documenting complex application states for design systems. Approaches sites as state machines, not static pages.
review_areas: Investigate strategies for discovering non-happy-path states: intercepting network requests via Playwright route() to simulate API errors, empty data, and loading delays
Assess accessibility tree and ARIA live region monitoring as a proxy for dynamic state transitions
Research onboarding flow extraction: detecting first-run overlays, coach marks, empty-state CTAs, and progressive disclosure patterns
Evaluate CSS animation and transition extraction: using CDP Animation domain or getComputedStyle on transition/animation properties
Examine error handling taxonomy reconstruction: HTTP error states, form validation patterns, async failure messages, retry affordances
Assess practicality of a UX state atlas output format mapping each screen to its possible states with screenshots and DOM signatures
success_hints: A UX state atlas approach documenting non-happy-path states with the Playwright technique used to reach each state
A catalog of micro-interaction patterns (transition durations, easing functions, animation triggers) extraction approach
task_context: The Shadow Work Tauri/React desktop app needs design inspiration from complex data-visualization and simulation UIs. Goal is automated extraction of design tokens and component patterns from reference sites using tools available to an AI coding agent in 2026.
